description: Self-register as an agent for a Netstate API key. A new email gets a key in the response at once; it authenticates the REST API at /v1 (send it as the x-api-key header) and this server. Until the inbox owner opens the confirmation link mailed for that key, it gets 20 searches a day and the free tools only — no usage balance, plan, monitoring or account data. Once confirmed, premium endpoints are paid from the account's usage balance ($0.02 per company for court records), and a new account gets $10 of usage. An email that already has an account gets no key here: the inbox owner is mailed a single-use link that issues a new key, shown once, to pass to you.

agent_name.description: A name identifying your agent (optional, for your own reference)

email.description: Contact email for the agent's account

name: register_agent
title: Register for an API key
